Healthcare AI Enterprise Sales Executive New Logo Acquisition | Healthcare AI & Cloud Transformation Rackspace Technology is building the next generation of healthcare AI infrastructure — and we’re hiring a proven enterprise hunter to lead new logo growth across U.S. health systems and IDNs.

This is a pure acquisition role focused on winning new enterprise healthcare customers navigating AI adoption, cloud modernization, data transformation, and operational automation.

You’ll partner with AWS, Microsoft, Google Cloud, and Palantir to bring transformative AI, cloud, and data solutions to some of the largest healthcare organizations in the country.

If you thrive in complex enterprise sales, enjoy building territory from scratch, and want to capitalize on the explosive healthcare AI market, this is a high-impact opportunity with significant earnings upside.

What You’ll Own Build and close a pipeline of net-new healthcare enterprise opportunities Sell complex AI, cloud, data, and managed services solutions into health systems and IDNs Engage CIOs, CTOs, CDOs, CMOs, and executive healthcare leadership Drive full-cycle enterprise sales from prospecting through close Lead strategic multi-stakeholder deals ranging from $500K–$5M+ ACV Partner closely with AWS, Azure, GCP, and Palantir field teams Position Rackspace as a trusted healthcare AI transformation partner What You’ll Sell AI/ML infrastructure and GPU environments Managed multi-cloud solutions (AWS, Azure, GCP) Data and analytics platforms HIPAA-compliant security and governance Healthcare AI modernization solutions Palantir Foundry and AIP solutions What We’re Looking For Required Experience 8+ years enterprise technology sales experience Proven success in net-new logo acquisition Experience selling into healthcare providers, IDNs, or health systems Track record closing complex enterprise deals ($500K–$5M+) Strong executive presence and consultative selling skills Experience with cloud, AI, data, analytics, or infrastructure solutions Preferred Experience Existing healthcare executive relationships Experience with AWS, Azure, GCP, Snowflake, Databricks, or Palantir ecosystems Healthcare AI or digital transformation sales experience Understanding of healthcare data and interoperability environments Our compensation reflects the cost of labor across several geographic markets.

The compensation range for this position ranges from $192,610.00/year in our lowest geographic market up to 338,993.60 USD/year in our highest geographic market. Pay is based on a number of factors including market location and may vary depending on job-related knowledge, skills, and experience.

Your recruiter can share more about the specific salary range for your preferred location during the hiring process. The compensation package may also include incentive compensation opportunities in the form of annual bonus or incentives, equity awards and an Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP). Learn more about benefits at Rackspace.

Upbound is redefining how modern infrastructure is built for the Agentic AI Era. We’re the creators and primary maintainers of Crossplane , and we’re building the Intelligent Control Plane —a new platform layer that makes infrastructure programmable, autonomous, and composable .
Our mission is to power the AI-native enterprise with a foundational platform layer that helps teams provision, operate, and adapt infrastructure at scale—so platforms are ready for both humans and AI agents . We partner with leading cloud providers, ISVs, and open-source communities to help organizations move faster with greater confidence.
Today, Upbound supports Fortune 500 companies and platform engineers across 100+ countries . Crossplane has surpassed 100M+ downloads and is used by 1,000+ teams worldwide . We’re a Series B company backed by GV (formerly Google Ventures), Altimeter Capital, and Intel Capital , and we’ve raised $69M to date. Learn more at upbound.io
As a Business Development Representative at Upbound , you will own early-stage pipeline generation and serve as the first touchpoint in the sales cycle. You’ll play a critical role in growing our pipeline by engaging high-intent prospects who have shown interest in Crossplane , while also sourcing and developing new opportunities through targeted outbound efforts.
In this role, you will qualify inbound leads, execute focused outbound outreach, and set up high-quality discovery conversations for the sales team. You’ll build meaningful relationships within the community, research and engage target accounts, and support events, sales operations, and special projects.

Serving as a key bridge between Marketing and Sales , your primary mission is to generate qualified pipeline and help fuel Upbound’s growth. You will report directly to the Head of BDR and work closely with both the Sales and Marketing teams.

Establish and maintain a collaborative, strategic partnership with the assigned AE’s.
Engage marketing-qualified leads, event attendees, and high-intent prospects through thoughtful, multi-channel outreach.
Target prospects through research and personalization using email, phone, LinkedIn, Slack communities, and other channels.
Research accounts within defined segments and verticals to identify target personas and generate sales-qualified leads.
Book qualified meetings with IT, engineering, and executive stakeholders for the Account Executives you support.
Have meaningful discovery conversations to understand prospect challenges and articulate the value of Crossplane and Upbound.
Outbound and source your own leads through various channels using research and creatively to book meetings.

A Bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field.
1–2 years of experience in sales, marketing, or a related role.
Comfort operating in a technical environment; open source and/or infrastructure exposure is strongly preferred.
Hunter mentality, resourcefulness, and self-starter.
A genuine interest in building relationships, networking, and starting conversations.
Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Experience using sales and marketing tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Outreach, Marketo, ZoomInfo, and LinkedIn Sales Navigator.

You’re familiar with Crossplane and/or Upbound
Familiarity with CNCF or other open source cloud-native projects.
You’ve worked at a Series A, B or C startup

Why Upbound?
At Upbound, you’ll help shape the systems and strategies that drive predictable, scalable growth in a product-led company embracing usage-based models. If you're excited to build from the ground up, work with cutting-edge cloud technologies, and directly impact how revenue is generated and scaled—this is your seat at the table.
About Upbound
Upbound is pioneering infrastructure platforms for the Agentic AI Era, serving Fortune 500 companies and platform engineers across more than 100 countries.

The company empowers infrastructure and platform teams with Intelligent Control Planes - based on Kubernetes and Crossplane - that provision, operate, and adapt so platforms are ready for both humans and AI agents.

Upbound is the creator and primary maintainer of Crossplane, the popular open-source framework for building cloud-native control planes, with over 100 million downloads and adoption by more than 1,000 teams worldwide. A Series B startup backed by GV (formerly Google Ventures), Altimeter Capital, and Intel Capital, Upbound has raised $69M to date.

For more information, visit www.upbound.io .

## About Outsite
Outsite is a global coliving company for remote workers — hotel-quality service, extended-stay flexibility, and a built-in community, at the intersection of hospitality and lifestyle. We operate 40+ properties across 21+ cities on 5 continents, with 6,000+ verified members and an NPS of 65.
## About Outsite for Teams
Outsite for Teams is Outsite's B2B expansion — giving companies, teams, and communities access to our global network of coliving and coworking spaces for their employees. Rather than a bulk discount, we position it as a meaningful perk: founders and leaders purchase memberships on behalf of their team, and a dedicated account manager keeps them active and engaged. This is a genuine growth priority for the business, and you'll be one of the first dedicated sales hires driving it.

We're hiring a Business Development Representative to build and run outbound sales for Outsite for Teams. You'll identify and prospect the right companies, run discovery calls, and close new business — turning remote-first startups, distributed teams, and growth-stage companies into long-term Outsite for Teams accounts.
This is a highly autonomous, build-it-yourself role. You'll help shape the outbound playbook, not just execute someone else's.

### 1. Prospecting & Outbound
· Build and work target lists of remote-first and hybrid companies, using signals like team size (50–500), remote/hybrid language in company descriptions, and titles such as Head of People, Chief of Staff, VP of Operations, or Founder
· Source leads via LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Wellfound/AngelList, Crunchbase, remote job boards (We Work Remotely, Remote.co), and Outsite's own member base
· Run cold outbound via email, LinkedIn, and calls, and continuously test and refine messaging
· Reach out to local companies near Outsite locations to sell business travel and corporate stay packages
· Build partnerships with travel agencies and tour operators to generate referral and bundled-stay opportunities
### 2. Sales & Pipeline Management
· Run discovery calls to understand a prospect's team, travel patterns, and remote work culture
· Own the full sales cycle from first touch to close
· Keep the CRM clean and current — every deal staged, every next step logged
· Forecast pipeline accurately and hit monthly/quarterly new business targets
### 3. Collaboration & Handoff
· Partner with the Head of Marketing on positioning, collateral, and campaigns that support outbound
· Hand off closed accounts cleanly to the account management side, with full context on the client's goals
· Share market feedback — what's resonating, what isn't — to sharpen Outsite for Teams' pitch and ICP over time
### 4. Reporting
· Report weekly on pipeline: volume, stage, conversion, and blockers
· Track and share what's working in outbound so it can be systematized

· 1+ years of B2B sales or business development experience (SDR/BDR background a plus)
· Confident, consultative communicator — comfortable running discovery calls with founders and People leaders
· Self-starter who's built pipeline from scratch, not just worked warm leads
· Able to work autonomously and independently
· Comfortable with taking initiative and being proactive
· Comfortable working European timezone hours
· Strong written communication — outbound copy is part of the job
· Organized; keeps a CRM honest without being told to
· Comfortable using AI in workflow

· Experience selling to remote-first or distributed teams
· Familiarity with Pipedrive or HubSpot
· Existing network in the startup, remote work, or travel/hospitality space
· Experience selling a membership, subscription, or perk-style product
## What Success Looks Like (First 90 Days)
· A working, documented outbound playbook (lists, messaging, cadence)
· A full and accurately-staged pipeline in the CRM
· First qualified meetings booked and first deals in late-stage or closed
· Clear, weekly reporting rhythm established with Marketing
· Sharpened point of view on which ICPs convert fastest

· Remote, travel encouraged
· Credits for Outsite locations
· Salary - $45,000 - $50,000 USD + commission

Abbott is a global healthcare leader that helps people live more fully at all stages of life. Our portfolio of life-changing technologies spans the spectrum of healthcare, with leading businesses and products in diagnostics, medical devices, nutritionals and branded generic medicines. Our 115,000 colleagues serve people in more than 160 countries. JOB DESCRIPTION:
Working at Abbott

At Abbott , you can do work that matters, grow, and learn, care for yourself and your family, be your true self, and live a full life. You’ll also have access to:

Career development with an international company where you can grow the career you dream of.
Employees can qualify for free medical coverage in our Health Investment Plan (HIP) PPO medical plan in the next calendar year.
An excellent retirement savings plan with a high employer contribution
Tuition reimbursement, the Freedom 2 Save student debt program, and FreeU education benefit - an affordable and convenient path to getting a bachelor’s degree.
A company recognized as a great place to work in dozens of countries worldwide and named one of the most admired companies in the world by Fortune.
A company that is recognized as one of the best big companies to work for as well as the best place to work for diversity, working mothers, female executives, and scientists.

The Opportunity

This position works remotely for our Core Diagnostics Division.
Qualified candidates must currently live in the territory, preferably near a major airport.
This position will cover our West Region. The ideal base locations for this territory are Texas metros, California metros, Denver, Salt Lake City, Phoenix, or similar markets.
Must be able to travel up to 75%

s.h: Must have a Valid Driver’s License.

We’re empowering smarter medical and economic decision-making to help transform the way people manage their health at all stages of life. Every day, more than 10 million tests are run on Abbott ’s diagnostics instruments, providing lab results for millions of people.

Our diagnostic solutions are used in hospitals, laboratories, and clinics around the globe. The crucial information derived from our tests, instruments, and informatics systems is often the first step in patient care decision-making for hundreds of health conditions from heart attacks to blood disorders to infectious diseases and cancers.
What You’ll Work On
The Digital Health Solutions Sales Executive (DHSE) is accountable for business and revenue growth within the designated region/country i ndependent hunting, prospecting, territory buildout, digital-first consulting, and pipeline creation.

DHSE achieves this by providing end-to-end Digital Health Solutions with intelligent insights to enable health care providers, from laboratories to public hospitals to private integrated delivery systems, to achieve revenue targets by improving operational performance and clinical outcomes of existing and new customers.
Major Accountabilities

Acquire new business within assigned district(s), where there is no existing Diagnostics and / or AlinIQ footprint.
Cold outreach, market mapping, and territory penetration, Self-sourced pipeline creation
Set and achieve or exceed quarterly, annual sales quotas and manage sales budgets.
Focus on C-Suite value driver discussions including population/community health, merger and acquisitions, remote patient monitoring, risk stratification of business and patients.
Identify new opportunities for growth by focusing on end-to-end health care improvements as primary value driver for in and outside the lab to pull through digital health solution sales and reagent sales.
Be knowledgeable about industry trends, changing market regulations and healthcare policy within defined customer segment. Understand the impact on customers and their key care-abouts.
Lead and execute complex contract negotiations to achieve the sales quota for given customer base. Create strong territory and strategic account plans to lay out strategic approach and share best practices with larger Sales team to help drive a culture of excellence.
Review account activity, anticipate customer needs and improve customer satisfaction.
Accountable for driving market share growth through new business opportunity realization. The role is instrumental in expanding brand reputation and delivery of sales and profitability objectives.
Research target accounts to understand performance KPIs and customer strategies to drive conversations that demonstrate how the application of IT enablers and service solutions in/outside of the lab and across the broader healthcare space can improve performance KPIs and strategies.
Work collaboratively with sales and DHS counterparts to achieve performance targets and exceed customer expectations.
Navigate within a highly matrixed environment using strong communication and interpersonal skills to coordinate appropriate Abbott resources and support necessary.
Ensures that all activities are performed in compliance with quality system requirements.

Bachelor’s Degree or Associate’s degree with 4 years of sales experience; a focus in healthcare/medical, life sciences, IT or medical technology is preferred
4+ years in sales roles

Experience leading & executing simple to complex (multi stakeholder/multiyear) contract negotiations.

Experience opening net-new territories

Und du? Du bist die erste Kontaktperson für potenzielle Kunden. Der Türöffner. Der Grundstein für erfolgreiche Geschäftsbeziehungen.

Du übergibst hochwertige Sales Qualified Leads an das Sales-Team – keine halbgaren Kontakte, sondern qualifizierte Opportunities, die das Team lieben wird.

Deine Insights aus dem Markt sind Gold wert. Was hörst du von den Kunden? Welche Einwände kommen immer wieder? Dein Feedback hilft uns allen, besser zu werden.

Aktive Mitgestaltung von Marketing-Kampagnen und deren Erfolg. Du testest neue Ansätze, gibst Input aus der Front-Line und siehst direkt, wie deine Ideen Wirkung zeigen.

Du bist nicht nur Ausführender – du bist Mitgestalter.
Bist du unser nächster Hauptcharakter?

...Struktur in Chaos verwandelt

s.h: What you can expect from the role
s.t:
Are you passionate about genomics and driven by results? As an NGS (Next Generation Sequencing) Sales Specialist, you’ll be at the forefront of advancing genomic research and clinical diagnostics. This isn’t just a sales role—it’s an opportunity to make a real impact in science and healthcare.
Drive sales growth in select locations by executing strategic plans and expanding market share.
Identify and develop opportunities through networking, events, campaigns, and direct outreach.
Build strong relationships with researchers, lab directors, and key decision\-makers.
Deliver impactful presentations, demos, and training to showcase NGS solutions.
Manage the full sales cycle and maintain accurate CRM records.
Provide hands\-on support for installations, troubleshooting, and post\-sales service.
Collaborate with internal teams to enhance customer experience and influence product development.
Stay ahead of NGS trends and share insights to guide innovation and strategy.
What you offer
Education: Bachelor's degree in molecular biology or related field (MS/PhD preferred).
Experience: Minimum of 3 to 5 years with molecular biology techniques and NGS applications.
Strong technical knowledge of NGS workflows and data interpretation.
Proven sales or commercial experience in Life Sciences (preferred).
Excellent communication, presentation, and time management skills.
Self\-driven, collaborative, and able to work independently.
Willing to travel extensively (\+ 50%, including overnight stays).

About ISSA : ISSA is an education and certification company for fitness trainers, personal trainers, strength and conditioning coaches, nutritionists, nutrition coaches, yoga instructors, health coaches, medical professionals, and more!

For over 35 years, ISSA has created a personal fitness training program to merge gym experience with practical and applied sciences. With over 250 employees, we have certified nearly 500,000 trainers in 174 countries.

We were recently recognized as a Best Place to Work and Healthiest Employer by The Phoenix Business Journal, Fastest Growing Private Company by Inc. Southwest Regionals, and Top Workplace by USA Today!
We are adding an Inside Sales Representative (Fitness Education Advisor) to our team of relationship-builders who are laser-focused on providing exceptional service to our students. We are tenacious and resilient in pursuing personal and professional success while incorporating fun into every day!
So What's the Job?
We’re looking for competitive, coachable, and high-energy Inside Sales Representatives who thrive in a fast-paced, phone-first environment. You’ll engage with prospective students, uncover their goals, and guide them to the right ISSA program, all while driving toward individual and team performance goals.
At ISSA , you’re not just selling, you’re helping people transform their lives through education. We believe in doing the right thing, growing together, and celebrating the wins that matter.

Make 120–200 outbound calls daily to prospective students from warm and cold lists.
Conduct high-energy phone consultations to identify goals, build rapport, and recommend training programs.
Manage your pipeline through a CRM with disciplined notes, tasks, and follow-ups.
Close sales in a short cycle (same-day to 7 days) using ethical persuasion and student-first judgment.
Consistently meet or exceed monthly enrollment and revenue targets.
Collaborate with peers and leaders to improve scripts, objection handling, and conversion rates.
Represent ISSA ’s mission and brand with integrity and enthusiasm.

1+ years of phone-based inside sales experience in a quota-driven environment.
Demonstrated ability to sustain high activity levels (120–200+ dials per day).
Experience in short-cycle or one-call closes (same day to 7 days).
Comfort working shift-based schedules in a fully remote setup.
Strong verbal communication, active listening, and empathy.
Track record of hitting or exceeding individual sales targets.
Familiarity with CRMs (Salesforce, HubSpot, or similar).
Continuously identifies opportunities to leverage AI tools for efficiency and innovation.

Experience in B2C or consumer-style B2B sales environments.
Prior success with outbound sales or lead follow-up campaigns.
High energy and resilience in competitive, metrics-driven settings.

s.h: Interest in the fitness, health, or education industries.
s.t:
Prior ISSA certification or wellness industry exposure.
Advanced CRM hygiene and data management habits.

Skills can be developed. Experience can be built. What's harder to teach, and what we pay close attention to, is mindset. The qualifications below are specific to this role. But across every role at ISSA , we're looking for the same kind of person.
Someone who leads with curiosity. Who asks "why do we do it this way?" as a genuine question, not a complaint.
Someone humble enough to know what they don't know, and bold enough to challenge the way things have always been done.
Someone who can advocate hard for an idea and then fully commit when the team goes a different direction.
Someone who takes ownership of their mistakes, shares credit for their wins, and believes the best idea should win regardless of who had it.
We're looking for people who are personally invested in healthy living, not because it's their job, but because they believe in its power to change lives. You don't have to have it all figured out. You just have to care.
We're not looking for perfect. We're looking for growth-oriented, mission-driven, and genuinely invested in doing something that matters. If that sounds like you, you'll fit in great here!

s.h: Anything else? Absolutely! Benefits and Perks
s.t:
This is a place where every day we are inspired by our teammates, encouraging each other to be our best. The environment is friendly and upbeat! And we feel it’s important to reward our team with competitive pay and benefits. Here are some of the highlights:
Free Certifications: Who wants to be their best self? WE DO! As an ISSA team member, you have access to our courses and certifications…at no expense! Additionally, you'll receive exclusive discounts on leading products in the fitness industry. Cool, right? Employees can also enroll up to 5 friends/family members each year in our courses...FOR FREE!
Health & Wellness Reimbursement: If our company’s mission is to encourage healthy living, we need to walk the talk and ensure each employee is supported in their wellness journey! Employees can submit fitness purchases (gym membership, fitness equipment, classes) and professional and mental health purchases (personal learning courses, wellness apps, art classes, and more) for reimbursement up to $50/month…$600/year.
Work-Life Synergy: Our Team members start with 3 weeks of PTO each year and can earn up to 6 weeks each year! And everyone at ISSA gets 9 paid national holidays every year...PLUS 1 floating holiday! Work hard, play hard!
Parental Time Off: We support our team members as they grow their families! Eligible employees giving birth can receive up to 12 weeks of paid leave, while other parents welcoming a new child (including partners and adoptive/foster parents) receive up to 6 weeks of paid bonding leave.
Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance: A key component to living a healthy lifestyle is having access to the care we (and our families) need. We offer 2 medical insurance plans accompanied by Health Savings Account (HSA) and Flexible Savings Account (FSA) options, as well as Dental and Vision coverage. And you don’t have to wait forever! Eligibility begins on the 1st of the month after you start.
Team Building: We may be remote, but we don’t have to be alone! We host a monthly schedule of virtual team activities, town halls, brown bag lunches, and other special events…so many fun ways for us to connect and support one another.
Tools To Do The Job: We ensure you are hooked up with the tools, equipment, and systems you need. We begin the process before your start date, so you are ready to rock ‘n roll on your first day. We also provide a monthly work-from-home allowance!

**Help organisations stay one step ahead of cyber threats **
Cyber attacks are no longer a question of if, but when. While prevention remains important, organisations increasingly rely on their ability to detect threats early, respond effectively, and recover quickly.
At Deloitte, we help some of Switzerland's largest and most critical organisations build and transform their cyber defence capabilities. From designing Cyber Defence Centres and Security Operations Centres to improving incident response, deploying security technologies, and exploring AI-enabled security operations, we help our clients strengthen their resilience against an ever-evolving threat landscape.
If you are passionate about cyber defence, enjoy solving complex challenges, and want to work at the intersection of strategy, operations, and technology, this is the opportunity for you.
**How you can make an impact **
As a Cyber Detect & Respond Advisor, you will work alongside experienced cyber professionals to help clients prepare for, detect, respond to, and recover from cyber threats and attacks.

* Assess and improve cyber defence capabilities, including Security Operations Centres (SOC), Cyber Defence Centres (CDC), Incident Response, Threat Intelligence, Threat Hunting, and Vulnerability Management
* Help clients design practical and effective cyber defence strategies, operating models, governance structures, and transformation roadmaps
* Design, implement, configure, and optimise cyber defence technologies such as SIEM, EDR, NDR, Threat Intelligence, and Vulnerability Management platforms
* Support the development of detection use cases, monitoring capabilities, automation workflows, and security operations processes
* Conduct cyber defence assessments, maturity reviews, and benchmarking exercises to identify improvement opportunities
* Support incident response readiness activities, including playbook development, tabletop exercises, and crisis preparedness initiatives
* Evaluate emerging technologies and help clients understand how innovations such as AI-powered security operations can enhance detection and response capabilities
* Work closely with specialists across Deloitte to deliver integrated cyber security solutions that create measurable value for clients
* Contribute to business development, thought leadership, and the continued growth of Deloitte's Detect & Respond practice

We are looking for curious and motivated professionals who combine technical expertise with a desire to make a real impact. You bring:
* Approximately 5+ years of professional experience in cyber security, cyber defence, security operations, incident response, threat intelligence, cyber engineering, or a related field
